title: AI avatar video content service for local professionals
one_liner: Productized DFY AI avatar video retainers for mortgage/local pros: headshot in → niche explainers out.
why_agent_runnable: Scripting, avatar generation, editing briefs, prospect lists, and reporting are agent-native. Brandon approves niche, tool spend, publish of samples, and outbound send.

ops_steps.title: Niche shortlist
ops_steps.detail: Score local pro niches (mortgage, insurance, medspa, real estate) by ticket size and content need.

ops_steps.title: Brandon niche + offer
ops_steps.detail: Pick one niche + retainer shape (e.g. 4 videos/mo).

ops_steps.title: Sample pack
ops_steps.detail: Produce sample scripts + avatar videos from public headshots/stock (tool spend needs money gate).

ops_steps.title: Sales assets
ops_steps.detail: Landing, Loom outline, pricing one-pager, case-style before/after. Draft until publish.

ops_steps.title: Prospect engine
ops_steps.detail: Build compliant prospect list; draft LinkedIn/email sequences — Brandon send.

ops_steps.title: Delivery SOP
ops_steps.detail: Intake form, script approval loop, render checklist, revision policy.

ops_steps.title: Retainer ops
ops_steps.detail: Stripe invoices after pay gate; monthly performance notes; hire editor only with Brandon hire gate.

human_only_checkpoints: Any purchase, deposit, ad spend, or paid tool upgrade
Hiring contractors, VAs, or licensed trades
Publishing listings, sites, ads, social as official
Physical pickup, delivery, install, or on-site work

hiring_and_pay_flow.how_agent_initiates: Agent drafts Upwork/OnlineJobs/Craigslist job posts, contractor shortlists, SOWs, and payment memos in plan drafts only.
brandon_gates_before_money: approve recurring retainer or inventory buy

unit_economics_sketch.tool_cost_notes: Avatar/video tools often $30-200/mo; watch render overages.
unit_economics_sketch.gross_margin_notes: High software margin if scripts+renders stay agent-led. Ranges are sketches only — not guarantees.
unit_economics_sketch.disclaimer: No income guarantees. Creator anecdotes ≠ your results.

first_7_day_agent_sprint: Day 4: Brandon tool-spend gate + first sample renders
Day 7: prospect list + outreach drafts (no send)
kill_criteria: Cannot produce acceptable sample quality at agreed tool budget
Zero discovery calls after 50 Brandon-approved sends
Churn >50% on first 4 retainers due to quality/speed
Brandon declines further tool or ads spend
